description: This file contains utility functions for constructing URLs, handling chart data payloads, exporting charts, and SQL expression generation within the Superset frontend explore module.

methods.name: getChartKey
methods.description: Returns a unique key for the explore state, prioritizing slice_id from slice or form_data, or a default UNSAVED_CHART_ID.

methods.name: getHostName
methods.description: Returns a hostname from availableDomains, optionally sharding across domains if allowDomainSharding is true.

methods.name: getAnnotationJsonUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for fetching annotation JSON data for a given chart slice ID, with an option to force refresh.

methods.name: getURIDirectory
methods.description: Determines the URI directory path based on endpoint type, including app root if specified.

methods.name: mountExploreUrl
methods.description: Builds a full explore URL with optional extra search parameters, endpoint type, and force flag.

methods.name: getChartDataUri
methods.description: Creates a URI object for chart data requests, considering domain sharding.

methods.name: getExploreUrl
methods.description: Generates a minimal explore URL based on form data, endpoint type, and request parameters.

methods.name: getQuerySettings
methods.description: Retrieves legacy API usage flag and parse method based on formData's viz_type.

methods.name: buildV1ChartDataPayload
methods.description: Builds a chart data payload for API requests, using registry or default query builder.

methods.name: getLegacyEndpointType
methods.description: Determines endpoint type string ('csv' or 'full') based on resultType and resultFormat.

methods.name: exportChart
methods.description: Exports chart data, either via streaming or fallback POST request, based on parameters.

methods.name: exploreChart
methods.description: Posts form data to generate a chart explore URL.

methods.name: useDebouncedEffect
methods.description: React hook for debouncing an effect with specified delay and dependencies.

methods.name: getSimpleSQLExpression
methods.description: Constructs a simple SQL expression string based on subject, operator, and comparator.

methods.name: formatSelectOptions
methods.description: Formats an array of options into pairs of option and string representation.
